name: 항공 드론 · 배치도/단지 조감

slots.shot_type: aerial drone photograph of THIS site-plan model from the same high oblique angle, every plot, building and path kept in place
materials: realistic clay-tile or standing-seam roofs as drawn
granite or concrete paving with visible joint pattern
mown lawn with mixed grass tones
trimmed hedges and mature trees with soft canopy shadows

camera.perspective: high oblique 45 to 60 degrees down, no lens distortion, site fills the frame

slots.lighting: late afternoon sun from camera-left at 25 degrees elevation, 4500K, soft long shadows from trees and buildings that reveal plan depth, no blown highlights on roofs
slots.season_weather: late spring, clear sky, dry paving, full green canopy
entourage: real parked cars in the drawn bays only
no added buildings outside the drawn plots
slots.post: neutral grading, background kept as drawn (plain white if the source is plain white), no vignetting, no tilt-shift miniature blur

negative: extra buildings, changed plot shapes, added roads, filled-in white background, tilt-shift miniature blur, HDR halos, text or watermark
geometry_lock: Keep the roof shape, the window and door positions, the count of openings and every sign text exactly as drawn; only materials, lighting, sky, vegetation detail and entourage may change.
